attempted_claim: Fix E2(z)=exp(z-1)=(1/e)*exp(z), which has a parabolic fixed point at z=1 of multiplier 1 with singular orbit 0, 1/e,... converging to 1, hence bounded postsingular set in the parabolic basin. Every dynamic ray of E2 lands by Rempe's attracting/parabolic landing theorem, so landing existence is given and not asked. Let b=(b_n)_{n>=1} over {0,1} be the factorial-block address formed by concatenating C_k=0^{k!}1^{k!} for k>=1 in order, which is bounded, aperiodic and not preperiodic, with super-exponential block growth testing the speed-ordered Cantor bouquet boundary at extremal slowness. Let g_b be its Schleicher-Zimmer dynamic ray, known to land at a finite Julia point. Decide with proof which holds: (i) g_b lands at an escaping endpoint; or (ii) g_b lands at a non-escaping endpoint, distinguishing the Alhabib-Rempe exploding escaping endpoints from the Evdoridou-Rempe totally separated non-escaping endpoints, and state its relation to the parabolic fixed point. A complete answer proves exactly one of (i),(ii) for this fixed parabolic map and address.
claim_type: escaping-vs-non-escaping endpoint typing of a known-landing ray
decisive_failure: The uniform pullback bound was verified only at fixed finite potential and could not be transferred to landing points without a uniform T-to-0 landing-rate estimate over factorial shifts; no complete proof of either escaping or non-escaping typing was obtained and no emergent finding is claimed.
